title: Shackles Shatter
next_chapter_hook: In the instant the shackles shattered, Chen Ji perceived a gaze that transcended the Heavenly Will—that pair of eyes, more ancient and colder than any existence he had ever witnessed.

text.content: The instant he stepped onto the path, heaven and earth spun. Chen Ji felt his physical form torn into countless fragments, only to be reassembled the next moment. That agony was not of the flesh, but a tremor of being stripped from the depths of his soul. The trembling from the depths of the Tianji Record grew increasingly violent, as if something was awakening, or making a final desperate struggle. He steadied his mind and surveyed his surroundings—a white jade staircase stretching into invisibility, chaotic qi churning on both sides, each step landing upon void yet somehow conveying a tangible sense of solidity. 'The fourth page...' Chen Ji murmured, the Tianji Record searing hot within his divine consciousness as the fragmented shackle patterns upon it visibly crumbled away.

At the staircase's end, a hazy silhouette gradually sharpened into clarity. Chen Ji's pupils contracted—that was a figure he had never encountered yet felt intimately familiar. White robes billowing, features refined and elegant, yet profound worry creased his brow. 'Chen Xuan?' Chen Ji spoke instinctively. The figure offered no response, merely lifting a hand to point behind Chen Ji. He turned, only to see absolute emptiness of white. When he faced forward again, Chen Xuan stood directly before him, close enough to touch, his eyes reflecting Chen Ji's own face. 'You are not him.' Chen Ji spoke gravely, yet discovered himself incapable of retreat, his legs seemingly nailed to the ground.

dialogue.content: 'I am, and I am not.' The figure finally spoke, its voice arriving from an immense distance yet resonating directly within Chen Ji's mind. 'I am Chen Xuan's final thread of obsession preserved within the shackles, and also the trial you must confront.' Chen Ji fixed a cold gaze upon the other: 'Trial? The trial of the shackles?' The figure smiled faintly: 'You have always believed the shackles were a restraint, have you not?'

text.content: Chen Ji offered no reply, but his silence itself served as confirmation. He had indeed harbored this belief—since the day he'd obtained the Tianji Record Fragment, he had been bound by this incomplete prophetic ability, each use consuming precious Heavenly Fate, each glimpse into the future demanding the price of his physical form. Was this not a restraint? Chen Xuan's form seemed to penetrate his thoughts, sighing softly: 'Do you realize, I was the one who initially placed these shackles upon you?' Chen Ji's head snapped upward, killing intent flickering across his features: 'What do you mean?'

'When I originally transmitted the Tianji Record to you, you were merely a naive child who understood nothing.' Chen Xuan's voice carried traces of reminiscence. 'The power of the Tianji Record was overwhelming, powerful enough that even the Heavenly Will would covet it. Without constraints, you would have perished in the torrent of fate long ago.' He waved his hand, and the surrounding chaotic qi suddenly dispersed, revealing images—a infant slumbering in swaddling clothes, faint light glinting from its chest; a child being pursued and wounded, blood staining the earth; countless scrutinizing gazes converging from every direction...

choice.prompt: Chen Xuan unveiled the truth of the shackles—they had been established to protect Chen Ji. Confronted with this unexpected revelation, how should Chen Ji respond?

choices.text: Question the True Cost of the Shackles
choices.description: Even if the shackles were protection, it does not change the fact that they made Chen Ji live like a worthless wretch. He needs to know more.
choices.visible_reward: Gaining the Truth of the Shackles
choices.risk_hint: May Shake Chen Ji's Obsession with Revenge

text.content: Chen Ji spoke coldly: 'Protection? So what if all these years I've lived like a worthless wretch, stepped on by others, made a laughingstock? Is this your so-called protection?' His voice carried suppressed fury. 'Do you know how many times I nearly died?' Chen Xuan's form fell silent for a moment before speaking slowly: 'I know. Precisely because I know, that's why I set the shackles so securely.'

choices.description: Since the shackles are protection, what Chen Ji needs to do is not destroy them but transcend them—let the protection continue, yet no longer serve as a restraint.
choices.visible_reward: Gaining the Crucial Hint to Transcend the Shackles
choices.risk_hint: May Appear Too Quick to Believe

text.content: Chen Ji drew a deep breath, suppressing the turmoil in his heart: 'So the shackles were never intended to imprison me from the beginning.' His gaze gradually cleared. 'I understand. You were protecting me while also restricting the leakage of the Tianji Record—am I right?' Chen Xuan's form revealed a trace of relieved gratification: 'You truly have not disappointed me.'

'Because the protection was so crucial, I established four layers of shackles.' Chen Xuan's form gradually paced, the surrounding images transforming accordingly. 'The first layer seals the complete power of the Tianji Record, leaving you only three hours of foresight. The second layer binds your Heavenly Fate with your foresight consumption, making each use like walking on thin ice. The third layer...' He paused. 'The third layer entangles your fate with other people's destinies, preventing you from standing alone.' Chen Ji suddenly recalled Su Qingyao's 'shared life' ability, his heart freezing: 'And the fourth layer?'

Chen Xuan did not answer directly, instead pointing toward those pursuing scenes: 'The fourth layer minimizes your presence.' Chen Ji froze. 'Do you truly believe yourself worthless?' Chen Xuan's voice carried a hint of bitterness. 'No, you were deliberately suppressed into being worthless. Possessors of the Tianji Record are too conspicuous, drawing countless covetous gazes. Only when everyone believes you are worthless will those eyes turn away.' Chen Ji felt something explode in his mind—so this was it! All those years of humiliation and endurance were within Chen Xuan's protection!

dialogue.content: 'But...' Chen Ji's voice grew hoarse, 'since you wanted to protect me, why did you make me endure such suffering?' Chen Xuan's form sighed deeply: 'Because I cannot protect you forever. Remnants of souls will eventually dissipate, and the shackles will inevitably face disintegration.' He turned to face Chen Ji's eyes directly, 'Therefore, I left you a path—the road to transcend the shackles.'

text.content: 'Transcend the shackles?' Chen Ji's eyes brightened. Chen Xuan nodded: 'I established the shackles, so their rules are set by me. There is only one method to break the shackles—understanding them.' He raised his hand, and the white jade staircase around him suddenly transformed into countless points of light, rushing toward Chen Ji. 'Remember, the shackles are not shackles but a wall I built for you. What you must do is not demolish the wall but open a door within it.' The points of light poured into Chen Ji's brow center, bringing a flood of information—Chen Xuan's lifetime of research on the Tianji Record, all his remaining insights, the final piece to break the shackles.

choice.prompt: Chen Xuan's legacy poured into Chen Ji's consciousness. At this moment, Chen Ji needed to make a choice—with what posture would he welcome this power?

choices.description: Completely merging all of Chen Xuan's insights with his own understanding, creating a path unique to Chen Ji.
choices.visible_cost: May lose part of the self
choices.risk_hint: Chen Xuan's will may influence Chen Ji's judgments

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes, allowing those specks of light to merge into his divine consciousness. He could sense everything about Chen Xuan—joy, worry, unwillingness, and that deep protective instinct. All of this was merging with his will, but he remained clear-headed: 'You are you, I am I. I'm grateful for your protection, but my path, I walk it myself.' Chen Xuan's figure trembled slightly, as if smiling: 'This is what I wanted to see.'

choices.description: Only absorbing parts useful for breakthrough, preserving Chen Ji's independence and uniqueness.

text.content: Chen Ji furrowed his brow slightly, filtering through those specks of light. He only took the parts related to the shackles, keeping Chen Xuan's other memories isolated. This was a gamble—might miss important information. But Chen Ji had never been one to covet quantity; he only took what he needed. Chen Xuan's figure watched him, eyes gaining a deeper appreciation: 'You are more composed than I imagined. Good, very good.'

As the inheritance merged, Chen Ji felt a revolutionary change occurring deep within the Tianji Record. The patterns on the fourth page's shackles were no longer cold chains, but had transformed into warm streams, encircling his divine consciousness. Those streams eventually converged into a single point, then—exploded. 'This is...' Chen Ji felt his perception expanding infinitely, the three-shichen foresight range expanding visibly outward, five shichen, seven shichen, nine shichen... until he could faintly glimpse a full day into the future!

But that wasn't everything. Chen Ji discovered that the consumption of Heavenly Fate was also changing—no longer a fixed deduction of five points per use, but dynamically adjusted based on the depth and breadth of the foresight. If merely roughly glimpsing the general direction, consumption was almost negligible; only when foresight was as detailed and comprehensive as before would it consume heavily. What did this mean? It meant he could use his abilities without hesitation at critical moments, without worrying about being drained of Heavenly Fate! 'Ha...' Chen Ji couldn't help but laugh—this feeling was too exhilarating, like a monkey finally freed from being pressed under the Five Elements Mountain.

dialogue.content: 'There is one final matter.' Chen Xuan's figure had already begun to turn transparent, his voice growing distant, 'After the shackles collapse, your presence will gradually recover. Those who once ignored you will begin to notice you.' His eyes flickered with worry, 'Including those who want to kill you.' Chen Ji's expression tightened slightly: 'Heaven's Eye?' Chen Xuan didn't answer, only leaving a meaningful smile before completely dissipating into the void.

text.content: The surrounding illusion began to collapse, the white jade steps dissolving into scattered light. Chen Ji felt his consciousness plummeting rapidly, then—abruptly awakened. He still stood at the entrance of the path, as if everything before was merely a dream. But the added perception in the Tianji Record told him this was no dream. The fourth page's shackles had completely vanished, replaced by an empty page with only four characters: 'Transcend the Shackles'. Chen Ji looked down at his hands, feeling the surging power within, and couldn't help but curl his lips: 'Chen Xuan ah Chen Xuan, you've truly left me quite a gift.'

He raised his hand, casually forming a technique. The next moment, an image appeared before his eyes—it was what would occur at the end of this path three shichen later. A lurking beast was waiting for prey to take the bait, and within its nest lay a precious spiritual herb. Chen Ji grinned: 'This ability is so much more comfortable to use than before.' He withdrew the foresight and strode forward. The old him facing such a situation could only choose to detour or fight head-on—because foresight consumed too much Heavenly Fate, not worth it. But now? Glimpsing the general direction cost almost nothing, he could completely formulate the optimal strategy based on intelligence.

choice.prompt: Chen Ji obtained the power to transcend the shackles, now he must decide how to use this power—whether to proceed cautiously and keep a low profile, or seize the opportunity to make a grand display?

choices.text: Continue to endure, advance slowly in the dark
choices.description: Although the shackles are broken, Chen Ji deeply understands that the gun is always aimed at the standout. He decides to continue maintaining the waste persona, secretly accumulating advantages.
choices.visible_reward: Maintain a low profile, avoid premature exposure
choices.risk_hint: May miss the opportunity for rapid rise

text.content: Chen Ji收敛气息，重新变回了那个懦弱平庸的杂役弟子模样。但他的眼神比以往更加深邃，心中secretly盘算：「凌渊、夜清、韩烈……还有那个一直盯着我的苏青瑶。你们的游戏，从今天开始要换个玩法了。」他迈步向前，背影在晨光中拉得很长。从外表看，他依然是那个可以被任何人欺负的trash。但只有他自己知道，trash皮囊之下，已经换了一颗王者的心。

choices.text: Test the waters, initially reveal one's edge
choices.description: Since the shackles have been broken, Chen Ji decided to appropriately display his strength within controllable limits, striving to secure a better position for himself.
choices.visible_reward: Gain a substantial elevation in status
choices.risk_hint: May reveal too much and bring unnecessary trouble

text.content: Chen Ji took a few steps, then suddenly stopped. He sensed the presence of the beast ahead, a playful curve forming at the corner of his lips: "Since I have gained abilities, I might as well test them out." He continued forward, deliberately releasing a hint of his aura. A moment later, an angry roar echoed from the end of the path. The beast had sensed the provocation and was charging toward him. Chen Ji remained composed, forming a mudra with his fingers as a sharp sword qi shot out from his fingertips—it was a low-level spell he had unlocked during the inheritance fusion, one he could never have used before while bound by the shackles. The sword qi whistled past, and before the beast could even scream, it was sliced into two pieces.

Chen Ji stepped over the beast's corpse and entered its lair. True enough, the spiritual herb grew in the deepest crevice of the rocks, emanating a faint, delicate fragrance. He bent down to harvest it, examining it closely—this was a Three-Leaf Qingling Grass, beneficial for Foundation Building cultivators to consolidate their foundations, and could be sold for over a hundred low-grade spirit stones on the outside. "Not bad," Chen Ji said with satisfaction as he stored the herb in his storage bag, "First bit of extra income." He turned to leave, but suddenly sensed a gaze watching him. That gaze was cold, distant, yet carried a bone-chilling scrutiny, as if eyes were gazing down at him from extremely high above.

Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply. That sensation was all too familiar—he had briefly felt a similar gaze on the day he obtained the Tianji Record. At that time, he didn't know what it was, but now he understood. It was the gaze of the Heavenly Dao's Eye! After Chen Xuan's shackles collapsed, his perception of the Tianji Record had become extremely acute, allowing him to detect this deeply hidden observation. The question was—when did this observation begin? Was it from the day he obtained the Tianji Record, or even earlier? Chen Ji forced himself to remain calm, continuing forward without revealing anything. He knew that before gaining sufficient strength, any reckless action could bring catastrophic disaster. Yet at the same time, an unprecedented fighting spirit burned in his heart: "Want to use me as a chess piece? Then let's see how it goes."

The moment Chen Ji stepped out of the path, the fourth page of the Tianji Record suddenly flickered with a faint glow. That light was not the seal of the shackles, but a brand-new pattern—carved by some unknown force, fine as a hair, yet radiating a terrifying pressure. Chen Ji lowered his gaze to look, and saw those patterns slowly converging, eventually forming a line of ancient text: "Heavenly secrets must not be revealed; those who reveal them shall surely be punished." He furrowed his brow slightly: "This is..." In the next moment, Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in his mind, carrying unprecedented gravity: "This is the mark of the Heavenly Dao's Eye. It has already noticed you—from now on, you must be extremely careful with every step you take."
